# Track 1 (ALFWorld) — v0 results

*Generated by scripts/run_track1.py per docs/design/benchmark-design.md. N = 299 queries over a 336-trajectory store (37 incomplete-label trajectories are candidates only). Bootstrap: 1,000 resamples over queries, seed 0, percentile 95% CIs. recall@k = fraction of queries with at least one gold in the top k; chance rows are exact hypergeometric expectations aggregated over queries. Values rounded to 3 decimals.*

## Lexical-control split (MRR by query bucket)

Queries bucketed into terciles by their gold set's mean full-text Jaccard overlap with the query (bucket sizes: 100, 99, 100; overlap ranges: low overlap 0.269-0.467; mid overlap 0.468-0.610; high overlap 0.614-0.761).
